# Close profile: Tallow Labs, Inc.

**Basis:** accrual · **Framework:** US GAAP · **Industry:** B2B workflow analytics software
(SaaS) plus implementation and consulting services · **Updated:** 2026-06-30

## Readers and stakes
Private company. A $4M revolving line with Firstmark Bank requires annual reviewed GAAP
statements and a quarterly recurring-revenue covenant. Series A investors receive monthly
statements.

## Business reality
- Subscriptions: annual and multi-year order forms under one Master Subscription Agreement
  (MSA v4). Billed annually in advance unless the order form says otherwise.
- Services: implementation, data migration, training, and consulting. Sold with
  subscriptions and on their own.
- Some customers buy through a cloud marketplace or a reseller.
- Sales commissions under the 2026 Sales Compensation Plan (`commission-plan.md`).
- Revenue policy memo: none yet. Deferred revenue has been kept on a spreadsheet that
  spreads each invoice straight-line over its service dates.

## Materiality
$5,000 per item, $15,000 aggregate for the month.

## Accounts
| Account | Type | Evidence each period |
| Subscription Revenue | revenue | billing system export |
| Services Revenue | revenue | timesheets, SOWs |
| Deferred Revenue | contract liability | deferred revenue spreadsheet |
| Unbilled Receivables | asset | none yet |
| Deferred Commissions | asset | none yet |
